subject: MAP Kickoff: AsterBio evaluation & target close timeline
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Ryu <maya.ryu@asterbio.com>, Evan Cole <evan.cole@asterbio.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: MAP Kickoff: AsterBio evaluation & target close timeline

Hi Maya & Evan —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to make roles, deliverables, and the timeline explicit so we can get AsterBio through evaluation and to a contract decision by mid-December.

High-level goals we heard:
- Validate model accuracy on AsterBio clinical notes (NLP extraction)
- Confirm latency and throughput on your dev infra (VPC test)
- Agree procurement/contract milestones so SOW and security sign-off happen before holiday slowdowns

Proposed MAP milestones (initial):
1) Share sample dataset & evaluation rubric — Nov 24
2) Sandbox access (private deployment) + baseline perf — Nov 30
3) Joint eval results + quality review — Dec 8
4) Legal/procurement review & draft SOW — Dec 14
5) Final decision / PO issued — target Dec 18

Can you confirm these target dates and who on your side owns the dataset handoff and procurement? I’ve looped in Rishi (solutions lead) and Grace (CS operations) who will support the technical onboarding and procurement checkpoints.

I attached a first-pass MAP doc and our evaluation checklist for reference. If that looks good, I’ll turn this into a shared Google Doc and we can add owners and specific acceptance criteria.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: AsterBio_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (draft MAP), redwood-eval-checklist.xlsx (checklist)
From: Maya Ryu <maya.ryu@asterbio.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Cole <evan.cole@asterbio.com>
Cc: Ravi Srinivasan <ravi.s@asterbio.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: AsterBio evaluation & target close timeline

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. This aligns well with our internal priorities. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Dataset handoff owner: Evan will manage the dataset export and has the SFTP credentials ready — he can share the first sample by Nov 24 EOD.
- Procurement/commercial owner: Ravi (cc'd) will lead contract reviews; he prefers to see a draft SOW by Dec 10 to slot legal review before holiday.
- Evaluation lead: I’ll own the quality review and will coordinate clinicians for the week of Dec 6.

Target dates are fine but one ask: can we move the sandbox access up to Nov 28? We want to run an initial perf sweep before clinicians dive in. If that works for you, I’ll confirm times to provision access.

Also adding a small success metric: aiming for >=92% extraction F1 on the core three entities (diagnosis, medication, procedure) for the pilot dataset.

-Maya
Maya Ryu
Head of Applied ML | AsterBio
maya.ryu@asterbio.com | +1 (617) 555-3221
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Maya Ryu <maya.ryu@asterbio.com>, Evan Cole <evan.cole@asterbio.com>, Ravi Srinivasan <ravi.s@asterbio.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: MAP Kickoff: AsterBio evaluation & target close timeline

Rishi / Grace —

Forwarding Maya's confirmation. Maya asked to move sandbox access to Nov 28. Can you confirm we can provision a private sandbox (VPC deployment) with:
- GPU-backed nodes sized for a 2k tokens/req profile,
- a test endpoint for 100 concurrent users, and
- temporary KMS key access for their engineers.

Rishi — I tagged you as owner for the sandbox + perf sweep. Grace — can you prepare an uplifted MAP with explicit owners and acceptance criteria after Rishi confirms capacity? If we can get the sandbox up on the 28th and sample data on the 24th as promised, we should hit Maya's timeline.

Let me know if either of you need me to join the provisioning call with AsterBio.

Thanks —
Kimberly

Kimberly / Grace —

We can support the Nov 28 sandbox date. Quick notes on next actions from the Redwood side: 
- I’ll provision a private sandbox in their VPC with a minimal GPU fleet and open a perf sweep runbook (ETA: Nov 28 morning).
- Need Evan’s SFTP details and a small sample (<=500 records) to pre-populate the KV/cache test. Evan — can you push the sample to sftp://files.asterbio.com/redwood-test by EOD today?
- Grace — can you author an updated MAP doc with owners and the acceptance criteria Maya listed (including the 92% F1 metric) and share a Drive link? I’ll drop provisional tasks into our internal tracker once the doc is live.

I’ve attached a quick runbook (redwood-eval-checklist.xlsx) and a short provisioning manifest to this thread. If all good, I’ll schedule a 30-min provisioning handoff call on Nov 27 to align engineers.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
